judgments.en_span: Third-quarter revenue will be published on 12 November 2026.
judgments.zh_span: Le chiffre d'affaires du troisième trimestre sera publié le 12 novembre 2026.
judgments.explanation: Both passages convey the same meaning: third-quarter revenue publication on the same date.

judgments.en_span: The annual general meeting will be held in Oslo on 12 May 2027.
judgments.zh_span: L'assemblée générale annuelle se tiendra à Oslo le 19 mai 2027.
judgments.explanation: The dates differ: EN specifies 12 May 2027, while ZH specifies 19 May 2027.

judgments.en_span: The ex-dividend date is expected to be 5 October 2026, with payment on 7 October 2026.
judgments.zh_span: La date de détachement du dividende est prévue le 5 octobre 2026, avec mise en paiement le 7 octobre 2026.
judgments.explanation: Both passages convey the same meaning with identical dates and modality (expected/prévue).
